subsegment: Combined-cycle gas turbine plant (500-1100 MW, 1x1 or 2x1)
description: Greenfield or repower CCGT with F-class or H-class gas turbines, HRSGs, steam turbine, ACC or wet cooling, and gas/water interconnects. Interconnection queue, gas tap, and emissions permits dominate schedule logic.
hard_deadline_themes: ISO/RTO interconnection in-service date with capacity auction tie-in
EPA NSR/PSD and state air permit milestones
FERC tariff and gas pipeline in-service date

typical_risks.description_template: GT/ST trains from {oem} are slotted globally; loss of slot extends in-service date by {months} months.
PSD/NSR permit conditions on NOx/CO and startup emissions may require SCR/CO catalyst resizing.
Variable bearing capacity may force pile foundation redesign for heavy equipment pads.
HRSG erection and large-bore piping crews are constrained by peer CCGT and LNG projects.
Outdoor heavy lifts and HRSG module setting are weather-restricted during {season}.
Network upgrades by transmission owner are not contractually owned but gate back-feed and synchronisation.

typical_risks.category: Owner change in gas supply config
typical_risks.description_template: Owner explores dual-fuel or hydrogen-blend provisions late, affecting BOP design.
Heat-rate and capacity guarantees with significant LDs require precise commissioning and ambient correction.

typical_issues.description_template: Module arrived with shipping damage requiring on-site repair.
GSU transformer failed factory test, deferring delivery {weeks} weeks.
High-pressure steam piping weld rejection above benchmark.
Transmission owner's network upgrade slipped, deferring back-feed.
Pipeline tap-in by interstate operator slipped, deferring fuel-in.
Emissions tuning extended commissioning due to ambient swings.
Sustained cold halted concrete and outdoor lifts for {days} days.
Rigging incident during heavy lift generated OSHA recordable.
Reliability run interrupted by aux equipment trip, restarting clock.

typical_co_drivers: Air permit-driven SCR/CO catalyst sizing increases
Acceleration directives to preserve capacity auction commitment
Differing site conditions requiring pile foundations
